purpose: Determine whether the approved protected corpus supports one complete, non-circular, positive producer for exactly one existing ValidatedInternalFamily kind and lock all semantics required for a later implementation prompt.
exact_inputs: Brain_LOCKED source policy, master protocol, pattern, degree recursion, evidence, decision, output contract, and source-evidence map
Sources_LOCKED manifest-verified transcripts and corresponding video only where a material transcript qualifier requires inspection
Current sealed ValidatedInternalFamily contract and its approved baseline
Current subject, ordered-child, observed-price, and normal-impulse candidate-view contracts
Current ten behavior implementations and seven structural producer attestations
All approved review conclusions, including frozen P005 and P006
trust_requirements: No model-memory or external Elliott doctrine.
No caller family label, slot label, endpoint, or completion assertion may be treated as proof.
Every positive family result must be issued by a reviewed source-specific complete validator and identity-bound to its exact subject.
Nested family inputs must be genuine ValidatedInternalFamily certificates whose producer, issuance, identity, digest, and provenance pass fail-closed verification.
A terminal/base case must be explicitly source-supported; absence must remain unresolved rather than be inferred.
P005 and P006 remain frozen unless newly approved protected authority resolves them.

if_source_complete: exact trusted input types and identity bindings
complete positive, violated, and unresolved outcomes
exact prospective implementation files and baseline procedure
if_not_source_complete: UNRESOLVED or CONFLICT classification at each missing semantic
exact protected source gap or conflict
minimum additional approved source or proposed Brain change required

shared_contract_impact: No shared-contract change is authorized. The review must first test whether the current sealed family certificate contract can host the candidate producer unchanged. Any required contract change is a new approval boundary.
dependency_impact: A successful locked producer design would directly open a path toward at least one family certificate and thereby one side of P007/P008/P009/P010 and diagonal composition dependencies. A review finding of silence/conflict prevents unsafe circular certification and identifies the exact next source authority needed.
selection_order: Prefer a source-specific producer with no nested family prerequisite.
If none exists, prefer the producer with a protected finite terminal/base rule and the fewest nested family dependencies.
Do not select a producer merely because cardinality is implemented.
If both families remain circular or incomplete, select none and report the source gap.
required_tests: Review-package JSON parses and contains exactly one resolved producer or an explicit no-producer result.
Every asserted semantic maps to an exact protected source locator and authorized source class.
Adversarial dependency matrix rejects cardinality-only, caller-labeled, manually constructed, copied, mutated, deserialized, cross-subject, wrong-position, and wrong-family inputs as proof.
Circularity analysis demonstrates a protected terminal/base route or reports unresolved.
No source review artifact is imported by Runtime code or registered as a producer.
Brain, Sources, all prior manifests, ten behaviors, seven structural producers, and the empty sealed family registry remain exact.
known_limitations: The current approved corpus may not contain a non-circular positive family base case.
Resolving P005/P006 may require new approved source authority or an explicitly approved Brain change outside Runtime.
Completion and position authority may remain separate unresolved dependencies even after family composition wording is mapped.
The review cannot issue certificates, implement a validator, or establish methodology by assertion.
future_baseline_if_later_implemented: A new additive methodology baseline only after a separate implementation approval, complete tests, audit, and unchanged protected integrity.
